description: Schedule draft posts in the customer's Postiz at the next good local time for each platform and language (or at `at`), within the per-channel daily cap and spacing. Only works if the customer allowed agents to schedule; posts with claims to confirm or warnings are skipped for the owner to review. Returns what was scheduled and why anything was skipped.

at.description: Optional ISO 8601 time; the earliest allowed slot at or after it is used.

name: amplify_schedule_posts
title: Schedule posts
